subject: PO field validation, invoice cadence and packaging constraints
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@clearnorth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: PO field validation, invoice cadence and packaging constraints

Elena —

Thanks for taking this on. We're drafting the purchase order on our side and want to make sure the PO your team issues will allow our billing system to map line items to the packaging/discount tiers we discussed. Quick checklist items so we don't have to re-issue invoices: 

- Required PO header fields: legal entity / bill-to name, vendor tax ID (EIN), PO number, issue date, remit-to details. Can you confirm any additional mandatory header fields for ClearNorth?
- Line-level needs: we plan to ship package pricing as SKU-based tiers (Commitment SKU + Tier code). Can ClearNorth accept line-level SKU codes and a custom field called "CommitmentCode" for discount mapping?
- Net terms: your procurement doc I saw mentions Net60 by default. For the first year we can accept Net60, but would prefer Net45 for faster cash flow. Is Net45 achievable?
- Invoice cadence: Redwood can produce monthly consolidated invoices per PO or per business unit. Do you require milestone-based invoices instead? If monthly, can you accept invoices aggregated by PO number rather than separate invoices per subscription?

Attaching our invoice guidance and a simple SKU->commitment mapping example to make mapping clear.

Thanks — can you attach your PO template and any remittance instructions so we can validate?

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Sr. Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_Invoice_Guidance.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: SKU_to_Commitment_Mapping.csv (CSV)]

From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@clearnorth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: ClearNorth Procurement <procurement@clearnorth.com>
Date: 2027-08-18T15:38:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO field validation, invoice cadence and packaging constraints

Hi Naomi —

Thanks for the clear note. Attached is our current PO template (v3) and the standard remittance instructions. A few answers inline: 

- Header fields: we require vendor legal name, vendor tax ID, ship-to (for goods) and remit-to address, PO number, and our internal cost center code. We can accept an extra custom field but it must be pre-approved by procurement (we can attach as "CustomField1").
- Line-level SKUs: We accept SKU codes as long as each line has a description and unit price. We typically prefer discounts applied at the invoice total level (we don't usually accept line-level percentage discounts), but we can include a free-text field on the line for "CommitmentCode" for reconciliation.
- Net terms: our standard is Net60. For strategic vendors we can do Net45 upon Finance approval; for that we need a note in the PO "Net45 - Approved by Finance" and an approved payment contact on the vendor side.
- Invoice cadence: we accept monthly consolidated invoices; please include PO number on every invoice line and provide a consolidated monthly statement. We do not do milestone invoicing for subscription services.

I've attached the PO template and remittance PDF. Curious about the SKU mapping — if discounts are tied to packaging tiers, our AP system needs a mapping table (SKU -> CommitmentCode). Can Redwood produce that as a CSV?

Attached: ClearNorth_PO_Template_v3.pdf, Remittance_Instructions.pdf

Best,
Elena Morales
Senior Procurement Manager
ClearNorth
[Attachment: ClearNorth_PO_Template_v3.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: Remittance_Instructions.pdf (PDF)]

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@clearnorth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, PrIyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-19T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO field validation, invoice cadence and packaging constraints

Elena —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the template. A few follow-ups and proposed compromises to keep things moving: 

1) CommitmentCode field: good to hear you can accept a free-text field on the line. We'll populate "CommitmentCode" and include a reference column in the CSV for AP to match.
2) Discounts: ClearNorth's preference to apply discounts at invoice total level is understood. For our packaging tiers that tiering translates to different unit prices by SKU; will your AP system accept the unit price variance without a separate discount line? If not, we can provide an additional line that shows the discount as a negative line item and include a reference to the CommitmentCode.
3) Net45: we'll request Finance approval on our side for the payment contact note. If ClearNorth can include "Net45 - Approved by Finance" on the PO, Redwood will expedite internal approval. If approval doesn't come through, we can proceed Net60 with a 2% early-pay incentive if paid within 10 days (this sometimes helps bridge the gap).
4) Invoice filename / PO number: please confirm we can include PO number in the invoice filename (e.g., "INV_202708-PO12345.pdf") so your AP ingestion can pick it up automatically.

Attaching a sample SKU->Commitment CSV (same format as your AP mapping request) and an invoice schedule spreadsheet showing monthly consolidation example.

If we can get the signed PO with the Net terms noted, our billing team will validate mapping and push the invoice automation.

Thanks — Naomi
[Attachment: Invoice_Schedule_Example.xlsx (XLSX)]
[Attachment: SKU_to_Commitment_Mapping.csv (CSV)]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-22T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: RE: PO field validation, invoice cadence and packaging constraints

Naomi / Vivek —

Quick internal confirmation from Finance/Revenue Ops: 

- We can accept Net60 as Redwood standard for ClearNorth, but we will prioritize Finance approval for Net45 if ClearNorth annotates the PO as requested. Please note: Net45 approvals will require a one-time vendor credit check and lead time of ~3 business days.
- Redwood Billing can generate monthly consolidated invoices per PO and include PO number in the filename for AP ingestion.
- Required mapping fields for automated ingestion: PO Number, Bill-to entity, Cost Center, CommitmentCode. Please ensure the PO uses the "Cost Center" header that matches ClearNorth's template; otherwise we will route to manual processing and it will delay the first invoice.
- Discounts: to avoid double counting, our recommendation is to keep unit prices per SKU that reflect packaging tier pricing and avoid separate discount lines unless the customer requires them; if ClearNorth insists on invoice-level discount, we'll add a negative line item referencing CommitmentCode.

Attaching internal mapping example for your reference. Once we get the signed PO with the Net term note we will request the vendor credit check and flip billing to the specified cadence.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Customer Finance Ops
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SKU_to_Commitment_Mapping.csv (CSV)]
